checks.name: Backend verify incl. QuoteIntegrationTest and CommerceConfigurationTest (PostgreSQL)
Clean-clone workspace incl. contract lint/drift and registry parity

scenario_results.observed: QuoteIntegrationTest: a quote mixing a meal of another kitchen is 422 MIXED_KITCHENS_OR_SLOT, a meal not offered in the slot 422, duplicate lines 422, over-maximum quantity 422, empty basket 422, unknown slot 404; a quote names exactly one slot and its kitchen. A mutation removing the kitchen check failed the test. The client replace-basket confirmation is verified with the web/native cart (MB-027/MB-031).

Two meals at 12000 piastres and a zone fee of 3000 with synthetic tax 0 give subtotal 24000, fee 3000, tax 0, total 27000 (stored and returned); pickup gives fee 0 and total 24000; with 14% tax 7005 gives 981 (half-up) and 7986. Requests carrying total, deliveryFee, unitPriceMinor, unitPrice or customerId fields are 400 and create no quote; fractional quantity is 400.

QuoteDirectory.requireValid accepts a fresh quote and refuses a stale one with recoverable reasons: meal repriced (PRICE_CHANGED/MEAL_CHANGED), address edited (STATE_CONFLICT/ADDRESS_CHANGED), zone fee changed (TOTAL_CHANGED), policy replaced (POLICY_CHANGED), slot paused (SLOT_CLOSED), 301 s of server time (QUOTE_EXPIRED); another customer's quote is 404. A mutation removing the revision check failed the test. The order placement endpoint that calls it is MB-018, which re-tests submission of stale quotes.

Delivery to an address in a zone the kitchen does not serve is 422 NOT_SERVICEABLE and no quote is created (no conversion to pickup or another zone); delivery without address 422; pickup with an address 422; another customer's address 404; pickup when the kitchen disabled it is 422 PICKUP_NOT_OFFERED. A mutation charging 0 for unserved zones failed the test.

One cook/slot validation, integer totals from the policy snapshot (policy version stored on the quote), serviceability and own-address checks, verified contact, server-time cutoff and acceptance window (409 ACCEPTANCE_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT 4 minutes before cutoff, SLOT_CLOSED after), paused kitchen 409, quote expiry, no capacity hold (two full-capacity quotes leave counters at 0; quantities above remaining meal or slot portions are 409 STOCK_CHANGED), immutable quotes (triggers), no usable policy 409 NO_APPROVED_POLICY, real policy cannot be ACTIVE unapproved, synthetic policies permitted only in LOCAL/CI (unit test).

findings: Self-review: contract allowed 50 quote lines while the server caps 20; contract and controller aligned to 20.

Proposed defaults recorded: tax base = subtotal + delivery fee, rounded half up; acceptance deadline min(now+15 min, cutoff) with 5 minutes minimum; quote TTL 300 s; per-item maximum 10 - all synthetic policy values pending O04.

Residual: commission is stored on the policy but not exposed to customers; order snapshots and posting are MB-018/MB-020. Policy administration and audited changes are MB-026. Client basket replacement prompt is a client story.
